_purpose: Canonical registry mapping each Alpaca paper account to the config file holding its credentials. No secrets live here — only identifiers. Update this file when an account is added or renamed; nothing else should hardcode an account number or a config filename.
_why: The config filenames were once positional (test1/test3) while the accounts had names, so the file holding the account called 'Container Test 1' was alpaca_config_test3.txt and the account called 'Pattern Match' was in alpaca_config_test1.txt. Two sources disagreed about which account was which. Filenames are now named after the account, and this registry is the single place that binds name to number to file.
_secret_rule: Credentials are NEVER stored here. Each account's API key and secret live only in its own alpaca_config*.txt, which .gitignore excludes via the alpaca_config*.txt glob.
